vocab.definition: the electrostatic attraction between oppositely charged ions.
a charged particle made when atoms lose or gain electrons.
a positive ion (metal that has lost electrons).
a negative ion (non-metal that has gained electrons).

misconceptions.wrong: Electrons are shared in ionic bonding.

misconceptions.right: They only conduct when molten or dissolved.

misconceptions.wrong: Metals gain electrons to form ions.
misconceptions.right: Metals lose electrons to form positive ions.

questions.secondaryText: In ionic bonding electrons are ______ from the metal, which becomes a ______ ion.

questions.text: Magnesium forms Mg²⁺ and oxygen forms O²⁻. Give the formula of magnesium oxide. [1 mark]

footer.tip: Metals lose electrons (+ ions); non-metals gain electrons (− ions).
footer.thinkPrompt: Why can't ions move to carry charge when the compound is solid?
